*Where Rest Is*

Midnight -  
silent bells toll without sound in my mind,  
echoing the call: "Come, let us go to the house of the Lord,"  
to strike my chest among the company of mute and deaf,  
“vanity, vanity, vanity am I,”  
but it rings hollow, empty, devoid of meaning  
here in the stillness of the chapel  
where a gentle wind from outside  
ruffles the candles while the bells softly, rhythmically sway,  
calling to all who are weary.
